fixes.what: Replace the height:0 / negative-margin trick with `.form__status:empty{display:none}` (grid gaps still apply to a zero-height row).
fixes.why: The empty status row doubles the gap between the submit button and the closing note (visible in index-desktop-4 and index-phone-4).

fixes.what: Add `@media (min-width:769px){.accordion__read summary{display:none}}`, matching the site.js comment that says the summary is hidden where every details is forced open.
fixes.why: A 'READ MORE –' control sits above text that is already open on desktop: dead UI that collapses the copy when clicked.

fixes.what: Wrap the matches() call in try/catch (treat a throw as false).
fixes.why: Safari <15.4 throws on the unknown pseudo-class, so every hover logs an error and the panel never opens there.

fixes.what: Close the drawer on click outside the header and on focusout leaving the header, and add `aria-expanded` sync on resize; optionally set the rest of `main` inert while open.
fixes.why: On phones the drawer only closes via the toggle, Escape or a link; tapping the page behind leaves it hanging over the content.

fixes.what: Remove will-change from .card (keep it only on the scrubbed hero/trunk/roots layers).
fixes.why: Three permanently promoted compositor layers for a hover-only 4px translate; wasted GPU memory on phones.

fixes.what: Move the unreferenced PNG sources (canopy-u3.png 5 MB, trunks-tall.png 4.3 MB, trunk-left/right.png, roots-floor.png, leaves-float.png) out of the publish root into a source folder.
fixes.why: ~14 MB of unused originals ship with the site; a wrong path or a crawler pulls them and bloats the deploy.
